title: File:Plaza San Martín, San Martín de los Andes, Neuquén, Argentina.jpg
claims: A bronze equestrian statue of San Martín on a stone plinth in Plaza San Martín, with a square stone clock tower behind and tall conifers on both sides; a low building and graffiti are visible at the base. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.

Commons titles the file Plaza San Martín, San Martín de los Andes, Neuquén, Argentina.jpg. The route page uses it as the 2026 finish reference at Plaza San Martín; the 2027 finish address is still unconfirmed, and the photograph is not a race-day scene.

The Commons author field reads Mro77; the file is marked CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); the relevant date is 2020-02-23 15:56:10; the file page gives a camera or subject position of 40.156947 S, 71.352622 W; the original is 1,536 × 2,048 px; 1,068,083 bytes.

The route page uses a 960 × 1,280 px; 442,432 bytes copy without cropping or colour change and credits Mro77, CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/), Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
